generation_parents.algorithm: Replace the pure nearest-neighbor rule with a scale-normalized savings score that divides the classical Clarke-Wright savings by the sum of the two depot radii (current-depot plus customer-depot distances), retaining a bounded angular alignment term and a tight-capacity demand bonus so distant and near-depot customers are balanced.

declared_hypothesis: Scale-normalized savings may balance distant and near-depot customers while keeping the advantageous incumbent structure.
